name: starlight-mcp
note: Optional. The Claude Project works without it — custom instructions + knowledge files are sufficient. Add this only if you want Starlight to read and write real vault files on your machine.

setup: cd Starlight-Intelligence-System && npm install && npm run build
npx starlight init --vaults   # seeds the six JSONL vaults under ~/.starlight/vaults
notes: The server is dist/mcp-server.js (the `starlight-mcp` bin). dist/index.js is the library entry point and does not speak JSON-RPC — pointing Claude at it fails silently.
The vault directory is passed with the --vault-dir flag. There is no STARLIGHT_VAULT_PATH environment variable; an earlier version of this file listed one and it was never read.
Use absolute paths. Claude Desktop does not expand ~ in args.
